newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline firms on draw.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline firms on draw.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline prices firmed on reports of a draw in gasoline inventories on hand at Midwest refineries, traders said on Thursday.

Midwest refineries reported a 2.98 million barrel draw last week that left stocks in PADD II at 49.77 million barrels, down 3.76 million barrels from the same week last year, the American Petroleum Institute said late Tuesday.
The draw came as several refineries, particularly BP's 161,000 barrel per day Lima, Ohio refinery, worked to bring processing units back on line, traders said.

The trade group said distillate stocks in the region were estimated at 29.71 million barrels, or about 1.13 million barrels above the prior week but still 1.43 million barrels below the same week last year.
Chicago prompt unleaded was bid 1.0 cent over the print, with later deliveries remaining 1.25/1.0 cents under the print and premium steady at 2.75 cents higher.
Chicago low sulphur diesel was bid 1.0 cent over the print for prompt and later deliveries, with high sulphur diesel 0.25 cent over the print.
Group Three prompt unleaded was steady at 1.0/1.25 cent a gallon over the print. Later deliveries remained 0.25 cent under to even with the print and premium was unchanged at 2.25 cents higher.
Group Three low sulphur diesel was unchanged at 3.75/4.0 cents over the print, with later deliveries 0.75 cent weaker. High sulphur diesel in the Group was 1.75 cents over the print.
